notes.title: 🎱 Regular Update – Localization & Gameplay Tweaks! 🌍⚡
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][h3]🌍 Localization[/h3][list][*][p]We’ve [b]added more languages[/b] and made improvements to existing ones.[/p][/*][*][p]There may still be some missing or incorrect texts, but we’re actively working on polishing them.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ll [b]continue improving localization[/b], and we’d love your help — if you spot something wrong or unclear, please let us know![/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 Gameplay Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve made the game a bit more challenging overall.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Relics and Stickers[/b] are now easier to access in the early stages, making repeated runs feel more varied and exciting.[/p][/*][/list][p]💬 We’ll keep moving forward with your suggestions, so please keep sharing your thoughts with us. notes.title: 🎱 Regular Update – Localization System Arrives! 🌍
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share that with this update, [b]the long-awaited localization system is finally live[/b] in [i]Ballardo[/i]! 🎉[/p][p]This is still very much a [b]work in progress[/b] — over time, we’ll be adding more languages, fixing any missing or awkward translations, and improving overall clarity so that everyone can enjoy the game in their preferred language.[/p][p]👉 [b]How you can help:[/b]
If you notice any text or words in the game that look incorrect, confusing, or out of place, please let us know! Your feedback will help us polish the localization system faster and make [i]Ballardo[/i] more accessible to players around the world.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and patience as we continue to grow the game together. 💜[/p][p]— NUE Games[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/33aab3e791a0be48e9e411d07f1981d0d7223e9f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ✨ Update – New Relics & Improvements!
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve got a brand new update for [b]Ballardo[/b], and it’s packed with exciting changes:[/p][p]🔢 [b]New Relics: Numbers
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/5a72446f1a9879ab3beec50364a47a34f49c7e11.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Introducing [b]4 new relics[/b]: Numbers I, II, III, and IV.[/p][/*][*][p]These relics are [b]linked together[/b] — each one becomes stronger as you collect the previous number.[/p][/*][*][p]To unlock the power of [b]IV[/b], you must first obtain I → II → III. Strategy and progression matter more than ever![/p][/*][/list][p]🎱 [b]Physics Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made several tweaks to improve the overall feel of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted to resolve the rare issue where balls could unexpectedly leave the table.[/p][/*][/list][p]🌍 [b]Localization Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’re aware of current localization problems and are actively working on fixes. Expect improvements in upcoming updates![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for all your feedback and support — it helps us keep shaping [b]Ballardo[/b] into the best experience possible.[/p][p][b]Jump back in and test out the new Numbers relics![/b][/p]

notes.title: 🏆 Update Highlights – New Multipliers, Relics & Challenges!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve just rolled out a fresh update to make your shots even more strategic and the competition fiercer! Here’s what’s new in [b]Ballardo[/b]:[/p][p]🎯 [b]Pocket System Rework[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pocketing balls now grants [b]score multipliers[/b] instead of flat point increases — skillful shots have even more impact![/p][/*][/list][p]🚫 [b]No More Negative Scores[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dropping below zero points is now a thing of the past. Play boldly without fear of score penalties.[/p][/*][/list][p]💀 [b]New Relic: “Negative Fan”[/b][/p][list][*][p]A mysterious new relic that changes the way you approach risk and reward. Can you master its effects? [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/a74aafada05329f091977f0c338301d7f299a97e.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]🏅 [b]League Base Score Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Early stages are as fun as ever, but later stages now pack a bigger challenge with higher base requirements.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ready to test your skills with these changes? [b]Jump back into the table and show us your best shots![/b] 🎱[/p]

notes.title: 🎱 Ballardo Dev Update – A Fresh New Look Is On the Way!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We’re super excited to give you an early look at something we've been working hard on – a major visual and quality update for Ballardo! ✨

Based on your feedback, we’re reworking the visual style and UI to deliver a more polished and cohesive experience. That means cleaner menus, sharper icons, and a smoother overall presentation while keeping the heart of Ballardo intact.

Take a look at our new visual style:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/67d221c35d86ffd6664b55d11563ca4d184ee812.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/bdf77c544380bd1fd17903b5b3a6d4d62bc287bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/1ff44df23c9c976f832ad946806f0b6fc5ba50c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395736/d4a1a3e6262b25f6395a1e5c21f312aacbb7570f.png[/img]


We're aiming for a bold, fun, and modern design that enhances clarity and makes every screen feel satisfying to use. From new sticker icons to reorganized shop layouts, everything’s getting a visual upgrade.

💬 What do you think of the new look?
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Leave a comment below — and if you like the new style, give this post a thumbs up so we know we’re on the right track!

🎯 This visual update will be added very soon to the game, and we can't wait to hear what you think once it’s live.

Thank you for being part of Ballardo’s journey – your feedback truly shapes the game.

– The Ballardo Dev Team 🧡
